verdict.rationale: First-party Drive developer docs list "Modify files in bulk" as a supported use case. Drive also applies folder-level access to every file inside it, which is a built-in many-items-at-once operation for sharing. Neither source describes a dedicated batch API, bulk UI actions, or scope and limits, so the depth is unproven. Third-party rclone mentions are user-side workarounds and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented batch endpoint or bulk-action mechanics, coverage of bulk operations beyond sharing inheritance (move/delete/metadata at scale), limits and quotas, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Access you apply to a folder is inherited by all files within it.
